formationk.setting.title: Formation K Settings
formationk.tooltip.steer_boost: Optimize the rotation of karts when riding a kart.
formationk.tooltip.packet_boost: Accelerate packets when riding a kart.
formationk.tooltip.enemy_radar: Show enemy direction arrows when riding a kart.
formationk.tooltip.overtake_gauge: Show an overtake gauge when riding a kart.
formationk.tooltip.auto_third_person: Automatically change to 3rd person view when riding a kart.
formationk.tooltip.noclip_camera: Third person camera goes through blocks when riding a kart.
formationk.tooltip.camera_mode: Change camera mode when riding a kart.
formationk.tooltip.spectator_camera: Change the camera behavior when spectating another racer.
formationk.tooltip.suspension_effect: Change suspension effect when riding a kart.
formationk.tooltip.player_body_lock: Align the player's body with the kart for a cleaner look.
formationk.tooltip.player_head_lock: Make the player's head follow the camera directly when riding a kart.
formationk.tooltip.smooth_engine_sound: Play sounds like versions below 26.1 for smoother engine sounds when riding a kart.
formationk.tooltip.bike_suspension: Change bike suspension effect when enable suspension effect.
formationk.tooltip.auto_save_delay: Delay the autosave during a singleplayer race to avoid lag.
formationk.tooltip.track_minimap: Automatically search the track and display a minimap with racer positions when riding a kart.
formationk.slider.riding_fov.tooltip: This option only works in camera mode 'default'.
formationk.slider.riding_fov_effects.too: This option only works in camera mode 'default'.
